fabrication: Pressure-shell liners, carbon frames, seals, captive fasteners, cable raceways, return-air grilles, retention loops, light channels and airworthiness placards are fixed detailing within each room assembly.
Exterior assemblies: ribbon tether and climbing guides, Earth and atmosphere, starfield, Aster Reach rotating cylindrical habitat, truss docking collar.
